entities.name: PMID:25424502
observations: In 9 healthy men, 60 minutes treadmill walking at 50% VO2peak followed by approximately 130 g glucose replacement produced lower total and incremental postprandial triglyceride AUC than resting control; glucose-replaced and unreplaced exercise did not differ.

entities.name: PMID:17998903
observations: In 13 overweight or obese men, walking at 50% maximal oxygen uptake reduced postprandial triglycerides versus control and versus energy replacement; replacement attenuated the exercise benefit without increasing triglycerides above control.

entities.name: PMID:26975542
observations: In 18 healthy boys, exercise at 60% peak VO2 without replacement reduced total postprandial TAG AUC by 15% versus control and 16% versus immediate energy replacement; replacement and control were similar.

entities.name: PMID:27366132
observations: In 12 overweight or insufficiently active men, brisk walking at 60% VO2peak with a partial 270-kcal snack replacement showed no significant triglyceride peak or AUC difference from sedentary control.

entities.name: PMID:19112157
observations: After strenuous cycling and sprints, glucose replacement restoring energy balance abolished the approximately 40% postprandial triglyceride reduction seen after unreplaced exercise; replacement did not increase lipemia above control.
